review_notes: I read the whole file and checked how Tropical/Basic.lean defines MinTropical, its order instances and tropOrderIso. The file only adds SemilatticeInf, SemilatticeSup, Lattice, SupSet, InfSet, ConditionallyCompleteLattice and ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder instances on the MinTropical type synonym, with to_dual generating the MaxTropical versions. These are the instances Mathlib would need for this type. They are not a competing definition of a concept that already exists. The proofs reuse existing order lemmas such as isLUB_csSup, tropOrderIso and untrop_monotone. I did not find a generic Mathlib transfer construction that would clearly replace them, so I abstain.
